text: "Do that and continue to what's left" — approving: Realtime is priced at $0.50 per million connection-minutes and $0.50 per million messages (publishes in + frames delivered out). Monthly allowances are per plan: Pro 5M connection-minutes + 10M messages; Team 25M + 50M; Enterprise unlimited. Per-app connection caps: Pro 1,000, Team 5,000, Enterprise 20,000 (one Durable Object per app). Goal: cheaper than Pusher and Ably at every size.
